issue.title: Bob Mac Capture Ctrl+Tab panel switch and show-path performance
issue.description: Ctrl+Tab (and Ctrl+Shift+Tab) in either Bob Mac Capture panel switches to the other panel. Capture keeps its draft and caret, and Refs keeps its remembered view. Showing, switching, and typing in both panels do less redundant main-thread work and spawn fewer bob processes, with no change to what bob decides.
